verse.text: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn't save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh's, and he will give you into our hand.

cards.text: Two armies face each other across a valley. A giant named Goliath shouts across at Israel every morning.

scriptureLine.text: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

cards.prompt: Tap each piece of Goliath's armor.

reveals.label: Spear like a weaver's beam
reveals.detail: Its head weighed six hundred shekels of iron.

cards.successText: He was covered in bronze from head to spear. And still he was afraid of nothing.

cards.text: David is only a shepherd boy, but he hears the giant and steps forward.

scriptureLine.text: David said to Saul, "Let no man's heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine."

cards.prompt: Drag five smooth stones into David's bag.
cards.successText: He took his staff, his sling, and five smooth stones from the brook.

cards.prompt: The giant calls for a fighter. Do you go out to face Goliath?

options.label: Yes — go out now
options.response: You step into the valley with a sling and five stones.

options.label: No — wait for someone else
options.response: No one else will go. The army is frozen in fear.

whatHappened.text: David went out in the name of Yahweh of Armies, not with a sword or a spear.
whatHappened.scriptureText: Then David said to the Philistine, "You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of Yahweh of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied."

cards.text: The stone struck the giant's forehead, and he fell face down to the ground.

scriptureLine.text: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone, and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

quiz.question: Who went out to face Goliath?
What did David choose at the brook?
Where did David keep the five stones?
